note: Sherman County NE (FIPS 31163) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county services page links only a GeoWorks subdivisions/districts viewer (sherman.gworks.com) that exposes no ArcGIS REST services, and the assessor viewer is a parcel map. The county's 2017 zoning resolution (A-1, R-1, C-1, I-1, RPO) is published as text only. Loup City's ordinance refers to an official zoning map that is not published as a service. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for Sherman County zoning returned nothing for Nebraska.
